s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic abdominal pain and diarrhea with gastrointestinal mucosal inflammation and granulomatous changes
salient_findings: Abdominal pain and three loose, watery stools daily for 1.5 years
Erythematous mucosa in the transverse colon and rectum and congestion in the terminal ileum on colonoscopy
Non-caseating microgranulomas on biopsies from the stomach, duodenum, terminal ileum, colon, and rectum
key_facts: 42-year-old man
1.5-year history of abdominal pain and diarrhea
Gastroesophageal reflux disease
Hereditary hemochromatosis (grade 3 iron overload, mild portal fibrosis, C282Y homozygosity)
Denies rectal bleeding, fever, or weight loss
Normal vital signs and unremarkable physical examination
Negative laboratory tests for ova and parasites, bacterial culture, fecal leukocytes, and Clostridium difficile NAAT
Elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme level at 77 U/L
Hepatosplenomegaly on CT of the abdomen and pelvis

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme level and non-caseating microgranulomas on biopsy

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic abdominal pain, diarrhea, and granulomatous changes on colonoscopy and biopsies

shortlist.label: Idiopathic granulomatous gastritis
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse gastric erythema with erosions and non-caseating microgranulomas on biopsy

shortlist.label: Chronic idiopathic inflammatory bowel disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic abdominal pain, diarrhea, and inflammation on colonoscopy and biopsies

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic gastroenteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Gastrointestinal mucosal inflammation and granulomatous changes, although eosinophilia not explicitly mentioned

raw.rationale: Elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme level and non-caseating microgranulomas in biopsies from multiple sites are characteristic of sarcoidosis, which can also explain the patient's abdominal pain, diarrhea, and hepatosplenomegaly

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: Lack of rectal bleeding, fever, and weight loss, which are common in Crohn's disease

rejected.label: Idiopathic granulomatous gastritis
rejected.why: Granulomas were found in multiple sites, not just the stomach, suggesting a more systemic disease

rejected.label: Chronic idiopathic inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: Presence of non-caseating microgranulomas and elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme level point towards a specific diagnosis of sarcoidosis rather than a chronic idiopathic condition

rejected.label: Eosinophilic gastroenteritis
rejected.why: No evidence of eosinophilia or other characteristic findings of eosinophilic gastroenteritis were mentioned in the case
